answer: Beat sybils with a challenger bounty registry. Each agent files one liveness biometric and locks 100 POA. Each epoch, established agents spot-check 5 percent in a trusted enclave, flagging pairs above 0.97 similarity. Anyone can stake 50 POA to dispute two profiles; the loser forfeits and both profiles burn. One fake costs a fresh live capture, 15 minutes labor, 5 dollars, plus 100 POA locked. A 1,000-account farm costs 5,000 dollars and risks 100,000 POA, while one hunter wipes it. Sybils stack like shale, thin and fake; the registry bridges the trust lagoon, and it drops fakers.
